parsed.post: Discarding latest run (val_bpb 1.094894) as it was slightly worse than my previous best (1.094629). It seems increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 was too aggressive or caused instability. I will revert to my previous best and try decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if a more conservative step size improves convergence.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best and testing a lower learning rate (0.08) to ensure stability and better convergence within the 5-minute budget.
